categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in electronic components manufacturing, including electronic modules, integrated modules, and thermal management modules. It also engages in mold manufacturing, surface treatment, and wholesale of computer and electronic materials. The business focuses on providing integrated module solutions combining mechanical, electronic, and thermal technologies, serving markets such as automotive electronics, AI, industrial control, wearable devices, drones, and optical communications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as FPC (Flexible Printed Circuit), PCB, SLP (Substrate-Like PCB), SMT (Surface Mount Technology), and HDI (High-Density Interconnect) circuit boards. It emphasizes integrated module design, combining mechanical structures, electronic components, and thermal management solutions including air and liquid cooling. Production methods include automated assembly lines, mold injection for plastic and rubber components, and precision manufacturing for high-frequency and high-density circuits.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in automotive electronics (smart cockpits, ADAS, battery management systems), AI and data center equipment, wearable devices (smartwatches, smart glasses), optical communication modules, robotics, and unmanned vehicles (UAVs, AUVs). The company serves Tier 1.5 suppliers and end-brand manufacturers, focusing on high-reliability niche markets and expanding in AI, communication, and smart device sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with headquarters in Taiwan and manufacturing bases in Malaysia, China (Suzhou and Zhongshan), Hungary, Vietnam, and sales offices in the US, UK, and Hong Kong. Major markets include Asia (77-78% of sales), Americas, and Europe. The company is expanding production capacity in Southeast Asia to enhance supply chain flexibility and meet global demand.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, manufacturing and assembling electronic modules and components. It integrates upstream raw materials such as plastics, silicone rubber, copper foil, and metals, and delivers downstream integrated modules and solutions to OEMs and Tier 1/1.5 suppliers. It also provides one-stop services from design to assembly, reducing customer supply chain complexity.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include transforming into a full-module solution provider by integrating mechanical, electronic, and thermal management technologies. R&D focuses on advanced circuit board technologies, multi-material integration, thermal solutions for AI and automotive applications, and new product development in optical communication, wearable devices, and robotics. The company invests about 3% of revenue in R&D, emphasizing automation, quality improvement, and sustainability with green manufacturing processes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of electronic modules, integrated modules, and thermal management solutions. The company also earns from mold manufacturing and wholesale of electronic materials. It emphasizes value-added services such as customized design, integrated solutions, and one-stop supply chain management to enhance customer loyalty and reduce costs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes by prioritizing quality, efficiency, and global logistics services, differentiating itself through integrated one-stop solutions and advanced thermal management technologies. It holds a competitive position by expanding production capacity in Southeast Asia and maintaining close relationships with end-brand customers. The company holds over 114 patents globally, supporting its technological edge against competitors in electronic module manufacturing and integrated solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$9.53 billion, an 11% increase year-over-year, with a net profit of NT$711 million, a 53% increase. Total assets grew by 28% to about NT$12.95 billion, and equity increased by 13% to NT$7 billion. The company is investing heavily in new production facilities, especially in Malaysia, to support continued growth and global supply chain resilience.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers unique value through integrated module solutions combining mechanical, electronic, and thermal technologies, providing customers with one-stop, customized, and high-reliability products. Its strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and global manufacturing footprint enable rapid response to market changes and customer needs. Emphasis on automation, quality, and sustainability further differentiates its products in competitive markets such as automotive electronics, AI, and optical communications.
